facts: The Endpoints table enumerates the five existing project property CRUD operations.

Attaching a property to a type links existing create and attach operations; the options sections link existing option list and create operations, and the introduction links workspace property listing as the equivalent surface.
The property type and relation_type tables describe value/default shapes, not separate value endpoints. display_name is writable and name is derived.
Defining options describes inline choices on property create/update; deactivation uses the existing update operation and deletion uses the existing delete operation, not additional actions.
